summary_en: House of Rose announced the execution of share repurchase at 1,371 yen per share on November 19, 2026, via ToSTNeT-3 for up to 42,000 shares (0.89% of outstanding shares) and up to 57.58 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-auction Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: House of Rose's Board of Directors resolved on November 18, 2026 to execute the acquisition of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3). The company will place a buy order at the closing price of 1,371 yen per share on November 18, 2026, during the ToSTNeT-3 trading session on the morning of November 19, 2026. The repurchase will be for up to 42,000 shares with a maximum total amount of 57.58 million yen, representing 0.89% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock, which numbered 4,702,430 shares as of October 31, 2026). The execution is stated to improve capital efficiency and implement flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions. Results will be announced after the trading session closes on November 19, 2026.
